A '''period''' of [[Time/Legends|time]], following the [[Manderon Period]], lasted until the outbreak of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] that marked the beginning of the [[Old Sith Wars]] in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].

==Timeline from the Manderon Period until the Old Sith Wars==
*[[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]
**The Unification Wars come to an end, with the Koros system united under [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] Teta's rule.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Marka Ragnos dies, prompting a [[Funeral of Marka Ragnos|duel]] between the rival Sith Lords [[Ludo Kressh]] and [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], who both seek to succeed Ragnos. As Ragnos's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] looks on, Sadow emerges victorious and is anointed the new Dark Lord of the Sith.<ref name="Golden Age">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''</ref>
**The [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]&mdash;a galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire&mdash;erupts when two young hyperspace scouts, [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]], accidentally make contact with the Sith.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Manderon Period ends.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Sadow instigates the Great Hyperspace War in hopes of conquering the Republic, invading major Republic worlds such as Coruscant and the Koros system along the [[Daragon Trail]] hyperlane.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Holocron of King Adas|Holocron]] of King [[Adas]] is lost on the planet [[Ashas Ree/Legends|Ashas Ree]] following the death of its owner, Lord [[Garu]].<ref name="Evil Never Dies">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>
**Sadow's forces are ultimately driven back when his forces are revealed to be largely illusions, and Sadow flees back to the Sith Empire, where he is confronted by Ludo Kressh.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Sadow escapes after destroying Kressh's fleet just ahead of a Republic fleet pursuing him, and ultimately finds refuge on the moon of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Sith starship ''[[Omen]]'' crashes on the remote planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], stranding its crew as the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], while its sister ship [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] is thrown into the future and arrives around [[41 ABY]].<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>
**Supreme Chancellor [[Pultimo]] orders an invasion of the Stygian Caldera to wipe out the remains of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Atlas" />
**A [[Din supernova|supernova]] occurs in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], forming the [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**Duros scouts discover the planet [[Adnerem]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Alien Encounters">{{JournalCite|11|Alien Encounters}}</ref>
**Csilla undergoes an ice age, blanketing its surface with glaciers and forcing the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] species to move underground. {{Circa}}<ref name="Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
**The symbol of the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] is carved into the moon of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], earning it the name of the [[Mascot Moon]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Hearing">{{WEGCite|book=Dark Empire Sourcebook|story=The Hearing}}</ref>
*[[4999 BBY]]
**The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] calls the remaining Sith Lords of the Empire to his homeworld of [[Nathema]], where he binds their wills to his own and conducts a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|powerful ritual]] of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]]. The [[Ritual of Nathema]] strips the Force from the entire planet, killing everyone on the world except Vitiate; Vitiate is made immortal and immensely powerful, becoming the Sith Emperor.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>
**Blaming Nathema's destruction on the Jedi, the Sith Emperor gathers the remains of the Empire and embarks on a length [[Sith exodus|exodus]] from Sith Space.<ref name="Revan" />
*[[4998 BBY]]
**[[Ravilan Wroth]] permanently injures his leg in a confrontation with an [[uvak]] on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="Paragon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''</ref>
*c. [[4995 BBY]]
**[[Nida Korsin]] is born to [[Grand Lord]] [[Yaru Korsin]] of the Lost Tribe and his wife, [[Seelah Korsin|Seelah]].<ref name="Savior">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Savior]]''</ref>
*c. [[4992 BBY]]
**[[Ebya T'dell]] is born on Kesh.<ref name="Paragon" />
*[[4987 BBY]]
**The [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] worker [[Finn Vaal]], son of [[Adari Vaal]], dies in a construction accident.<ref name="Savior" />
*[[4985 BBY]]
**Ravilan Wroth poisons a Keshiri village with [[cyanogen silicate]] in an attempt to encourage the Lost Tribe to escape from Kesh, but Seelah Korsin poisons more villages and frames Wroth for the massacre. Wroth and the fifty-seven remaining pureblood Sith are executed as a result.<ref name="Paragon" />
*[[4980 BBY]]
**The Sith exiles arrive on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where the Sith Emperor establishes a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Revan" />
*[[4975 BBY]]
**Yaru Korsin dies following an uprising led by his wife Seelah, and his daughter Nida suceeds him as Grand Lord.<ref name="Savior" />
*[[4960 BBY]]
**Nida Korsin bears a son named [[Donellan]].<ref name="Purgatory">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]''</ref>
*c. [[4904 BBY]]
**[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Odile Vaiken]]'s [[Odile Vaiken's final campaign|final campaign]] against alien species ends with his death.<ref name="Timeline 11">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}}</ref>
*[[4896 BBY]]
**Nida Korsin's seventy-nine-year reign as Grand Lord ends with her death.<ref name="Pantheon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pantheon]]''</ref>
*[[4800 BBY]]
**The [[Gank Massacres]] begin: with the discovery of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]], the newly-discovered [[Porporite]] species is whipped into a homicidal frenzy by the spice, prompting various factions to hire mercenaries from the [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] species to protect them. The Gank exterminated the Porporites and went on a violent rampage of their own.<ref name="NEC" />
**The [[Quake Years]] occur on [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]].<ref name="Tinker Tailor">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>
*[[4789 BBY]]
**Master Jumper [[Barkin (Galactic Republic)|Barkin]] leads a group of Republic rocket-jumpers on a combat mission during the Gank Massacres.<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
*[[4775 BBY]]
**The Gank Massacres are brought to an end by Jedi Knights and the [[Juggernaut war droid]]s, droids commissioned by Chancellor [[Vocatara]] to assist the Republic against the Ganks.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*c. [[4645 BBY]]
**The Sith Lord [[Darth Drear]] establishes a [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]], under which he builds a secret temple to store his [[Darth Drear's holocron|holocron]].<ref name="Red Harvest">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref>
*[[4606 BBY]]
**The Sith Lord [[Kel'eth Ur]] is [[Death/Legends|killed]] for his heretical [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] teachings by the Sith Emperor, and his body is entombed in the [[Dark Temple]] on Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Buried Power">{{TORcite|type=general|Buried Power|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>
*c. [[4600 BBY]]
**Roughly around this time, a group of Jedi including the Duinuogwuin [[Willm Lywin]] establish the [[Teyan Praxeum]] on the planet [[Teya IV]].<ref name="Dangerous">{{JournalCite|11|The Most Dangerous Foe}}</ref>
*[[4598 BBY]]

*c. [[4500 BBY]]
**Parties from the Republic begin to contact the planet Kamino, seeking to make use of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]]' exceptional cloning technology.<ref name="Atlas" />
**By this time, Republic scouts had discovered the star systems of the future [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**The Altiri and Anarrians come into contact with each other, sparking a global conflict that lasts for almost six hundred years.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
**An independent scout vessel drops out hyperspace too close to the gravity well of the planet [[Iol]], causing the pilot to crash on the planet and inadvertently uncovering a large vein of ore used in the creation of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. The pilot names the planet Iol and submits a claim to the world, but [[Tangan Industries]] intercepts and modifies his claim to give the company rights to the world.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
**The [[Barabel War]], a millennia-long conflict among the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] species, erupts due to disputes over hunting grounds on their homeworld of [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]].<ref name="New Alien">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
*c. [[4498 BBY]]
**Tangan Industries has completed a full mining colony on Iol, which expands into three cities scattered across the planet over the next few centuries.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
*[[4400 BBY]]
**After being denied Knighthood, a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Freedon Nadd]] explores the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] and encounters Naga Sadow, who sways Nadd to the dark side of the Force. Nadd kills Sadow and establishes himself as a king on the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], where he institutes a policy to banish criminals into the wilds beyond the walls of the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. Nadd establishes a dynasty of dark side-wielding monarchs.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
**The exiled criminals manage to tame Onderon's wild beasts to become the [[Beast Riders]], and the Beast Riders wage war on Iziz, sparking the [[Beast Wars]].<ref name="NEC" />
**The Mon Calamari of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] begin to launch starliners to colonize planets around their homeworld over the next two centuries. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
**Around this time, a team of Jedi Knights including the Devaronian [[Chamma]] are sent to investigate a distress call on the planet [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]]. There, the group is attacked by Sith devotees, and Chamma succumbs to the dark side during the encounter. Disappointed in his failure, Chamma goes into self-imposed exile on [[H'ratth]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Tales Companion">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
*[[4300 BBY/Legends|4300 BBY]]
**The [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] Jedi Master [[Noab Hulis]] arrives on H'ratth and speaks with Chamma, convincing him to return to the light and end his exile.<ref name="Tales Companion" />
*[[4250 BBY]]
**The [[Third Great Schism]] erupts as Dark Jedi wage war against their fellows on Coruscant. The Dark Jedi are eventually driven offworld and retreat to the [[Vultar system/Legends|Vultar system]], where their attempt to harness the power of the [[Cosmic Turbine]] ends in the [[Vultar Cataclysm]]&mdash;the annihilation of the entire [[Vultar]] system.<ref name="NEC" />
**The [[Wingmaw/Legends|wingmaw]] and its primary predator, the [[Balmorran maweater]], are accidentally carried from their [[Unidentified Balmorra island chain|home island chain]] to the mainland of the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Wingmaw">{{TORcite|type=codex|Wingmaw}}</ref>
*[[4225 BBY]]
**The [[Kaikieli Reconquista]]&mdash;Jedi Master [[Vandar Tokare]] and his two Padawans lead Republic troops in conquering the corrupt world of [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]].<ref name="Tinker Tailor" />
*c. [[4200 BBY]]
**The [[Mecrosa Order]] is founded on [[Nyssa]] by [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscountess]] [[Mireya]], though the organization is corrupted&mdash;allegedly by Mireya herself&mdash;by Sith teachings over the next two centuries.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith" />
**The planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] is first settled by offworlders.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]] seeks to be admitted to the Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] becomes a haven for the [[Lorell Raiders]], a group of pirates who prowl the Perlemian for generations.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]] is colonized by pilgrims from [[Ator/Legends|Ator]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*c. [[4100s BBY]]
**New navicomputer technology begins to render jump-beacons obsolete.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*[[4166 BBY]]
**The Mon Calamari species makes first contact with the Republic when Republic scouts encounter Mon Calamari starships near [[Ruisto]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**The planet [[Darvannis]] is discovered by spice smugglers in the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Darvannis">{{TORcite|type=codex|Darvannis}}</ref>
*[[4129 BBY]]
**The [[Luire system]] is discovered and surveyed by the Republic.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>
*c. [[4100 BBY]]
**[[Bacta/Legends|Bacta]] is introduced to the galaxy, becoming a competitor to [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[4086 BBY]]
**''[[Trampeta's Star Guide]]'' is first published.<ref name="New Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
*[[4085 BBY]]
**A vintage of wine that will become known as the particularly rare Ord Mantell 432 BTC is produced on Ord Mantell.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
*[[4070 BBY]]
**[[Amanoa]], future queen of Onderon and wife of [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]], is born.<ref name="Beast Wars 1">[[Tales of the Jedi 1|''Tales of the Jedi'' 1]]</ref>
*[[4067 BBY]]
**The Republic exploration vessel [[Starveil (starship)|''Starveil'']] is lost while performing a study of the Luire system; the ship's last communication indicates that the crew planned to land on the fifth planet [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], but the ship is never found.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />
*c. [[4056 BBY]]
**The [[Dynamet Corporation]] donates a large sum of credits to the hospital [[Dynamet General Hospital|Mercy General]] on Taris for the construction of a wing devoted to curing the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]. The hospital is renamed Dynamet General in thanks.<ref name="Dynamet General">{{TORcite|type=codex|Dynamet General}}</ref>
**Around this time, [[Tarisian Civil War|civil war]] breaks out between Taris's nobility and the planet's largely [[Alien/Legends|alien]] lower class. The conflict is sparked when rising levels of toxic pollution poison the planet's oceans and famine sweeps the city-world, and the nobility begin to hoard food for themselves. Though the lower classes rise up against the nobility, the rebellion is ultimately crushed after millions died in the fighting.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
*c. [[4050 BBY]]
**Jedi Knights devastate the Lorell Raiders at the [[Battle of Lorell]], forcing the survivors to retreat to the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The Raiders and their female prisoners eventually evolve into the matriarchal and isolationist [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
**Scouts from the planet [[Shor]] discover the planet [[Giaca]].<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
**[[Drokko Kira]] is banished from the city of Iziz for challenging the dark side legacy of Freedon Nadd.<ref name="Beast Wars 2">[[Tales of the Jedi 2|''Tales of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref>
*c. [[4043 BBY]]
**The [[Dark Council]]ors [[Darth Victun]] and [[Darth Qalar]] fight a [[Kaggath (c. 4043 BBY)|Kaggath]] that destroys the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]], and both Sith are killed by the rest of the Council when it ends in a draw.<ref name="Imperial Citadel">{{TORcite|type=codex|Imperial Citadel}}</ref>
**The Sith Lord [[Darth Nostrem]] rebuilds the Imperial Citadel according to the Emperor's designs, and is cast into its depths upon its completion.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

*[[4030 BBY]]
**The [[Lorell Raiders]] are defeated by [[Arca Jeth]] and a team of Jedi, resulting in the hatred of the Jedi within the later-formed [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]].<ref name="NEC" />

*[[4024 BBY]]
**The [[Nevoota Extinction]] begins as the Mandalorians attack the planet [[Nevoota (planet)|Nevoota]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[4021 BBY]]
**The Nevoota Extinction ends with the extermination of the insectoid [[Nevoota/Legends|Nevoota]].<ref name="Warfare" />
*[[4020 BBY]]
**The [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] discovers [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the homeworld of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species, and claims the planet while renaming it "Edean."<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[4018 BBY]]
**Princess [[Galia]] is born to King [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] and Queen [[Amanoa]] on Onderon.<ref name="Beast Wars 1" />
*[[4017 BBY]]
**The Mandalorian Crusaders attack the planet [[Basilisk]] in the [[Battle of Basilisk]]. The [[Basiliskan]]s are supported by Republic reinforcements under Jedi Master [[Sidrona Diath]], but ultimately are overrun and seed their own homeworld with toxins to deny it to the Mandalorians.<ref name="Warfare" />
**The Mandalorians retreat from Basilisk, but take numerous Basiliskans, Basiliskian warships, and [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]] with them.<ref name="Warfare" />
**[[Keval Raffaan]] is born on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="Tales Companion" />
*c. [[4016 BBY]]
**[[Vici Ramunee]] is born on Alderaan.<ref name="Dangerous" />
*[[4015 BBY]]
**The [[Great Droid Revolution]]: the Czerka assassin droid [[HK-01]] seizes power by subverting the programming of thousands of droids and turning them against their masters. Jedi intervention finally brings the conflict to an end after three months.<ref name="Warfare" />
*c. [[4010 BBY]]
**[[Veni Ramunee]] is born on Alderaan.<ref name="Dangerous" />
**[[Candra Kitai]] is born on Kesh.<ref name="Purgatory" />
*[[4009 BBY]]
**The [[Systino]] crime syndicate discovers the planet [[244Core|Sraato]], a world rich in valuable natural resources. The Systino syndicate dominates most of the criminal activity in the sector for the next two hundred years.<ref name="Unknown Regions" />
**The Jedi Master [[Jev Sunrider]] dies on [[Krayiss II|Krayiss Two]].<ref>Andur Sunrider leaves [[H'ratth]] for [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] per [[Tales of the Jedi 3|''Tales of the Jedi'' 3]]. The ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' says that 2 years prior (4002 BBY), Andur went to H'ratth, and six years prior to that (4008 BBY), he saw the Force ghost of his grandfather Jev, who the Companion says disappeared on a mission a year prior to that (4009 BBY). If you start at 4000 and count back the number of years (2, then 6, then 1) you arrive at 4009 BBY, which has to be the year of Jev's death, given that he appeared to Andur in ghost form a year later (4008 BBY).</ref>
*[[4008 BBY]]
**Jev Sunrider's Force ghost appears to his grandson [[Andur Sunrider]] on [[Darada]] and warns him that he will play an important part in the coming war.<ref name="Tales Companion" />
*[[4007 BBY]]
**The [[Quesaya Border Conflict]] erupts, and the Republic rocket-jumpers play a role in ending the conflict.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*[[4003 BBY]]
**The [[Giju Run/Legends|Giju Passage]] is blazed by Herglic scouts, and within twenty-five years the route becomes an established trade route into Herglic space.<ref name="Player Tapani">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref>
*[[4002 BBY]]
**The Mandalorians attack the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] planet [[Kuar]] and [[Battle of Kuar|conquer]] the world.<ref name="Warfare" />
**Onderon makes contact with the Galactic Republic and encounters galactic civilization.<ref name="Beast Wars 1" />
**Andur Sunrider arrives on the planet [[H'ratth]] and begins his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] under Master Chamma.<ref name="Tales Companion" />

==Behind the scenes==
This time period has not been explicitly identified, although [[Daniel Wallace]] has indicated that it might be part of a larger [[Sidereal Era]].<ref name="Blog-danwallace|3">{{Blog|danwallace|3|Star Wars Calendars}}</ref> No official sources in [[canon]] have confirmed this as the dating scheme for the Sidereal Era mentioned in ''[[The Constancia Affair]]'' has not been fully revealed.
